description: Machine-readable metadata for all modality models

eeg.data_source_note: Tabular EEG features extracted from a fixed CSV. No subject-level identity split is available in this project pipeline.

meg.data_source_note: MEG signals generated with Gaussian noise (0.3) and frequency-domain shifts (0.5). Used for developmental pipeline validation.
known_limitations: Dataset is synthetic — accuracy does not reflect real MEG classification
High accuracy is an artifact of controlled class separability in generated data

mri.data_source_note: Structural MRI scans evaluated with the dataset's fixed Training and Testing folders.
known_limitations: Classifies brain tumors, not emotions directly
Mapped to sentiment via emotion_utils (tumor=NEGATIVE, no_tumor=NEUTRAL)

speech.data_source: Ryerson Audio-Visual Database of Emotional Speech and Song (RAVDESS)
speech.data_source_note: Audio-only speech clips from 24 actors. Labels are derived from the official RAVDESS emotion codes and mapped to sentiment classes for this project.
speech.evaluation_note: Model selection uses speaker-aware GroupKFold on train actors, then reports a final actor-holdout score on unseen actors.
known_limitations: Acted/studio-recorded dataset — generalization to real-world speech is limited
Only two statements — limited linguistic variety
Mapped to 3-class sentiment — loses fine-grained emotion labels
Random-split accuracy is often inflated by actor identity leakage; use actor-holdout instead

face.data_source_note: Grayscale face features with strong identity variation and a known train/test distribution gap.
face.evaluation_method: Train/Validation model selection (PCA components + SVM C)
known_limitations: FER2013 has a known train-test distribution gap
PCA+SVM pipeline has moderate accuracy — CNN would generalize better
Horizontal flip augmentation applied to reduce overfitting

fusion.data_source_note: Simple average aggregation is used at runtime because the saved LogisticRegression meta-model did not outperform the average baseline.
fusion.dataset_name: Pooled probability vectors from base models
known_limitations: Late-fusion by probability pooling, not same-subject aligned multimodal fusion
Trained meta-model does not outperform simple averaging on current dataset
MRI is not part of the trained fusion model (used as average-fallback only)
